inmate.starved.title: Inmate {inmateId} starved to death
inmate.starved.detail: Food need held above {foodNeed} for {hours} continuous in-game hours.

inmate.missedMeal.title: Ate {mealsEaten} meals in the last {blocks} meal blocks
inmate.missedMeal.detail: Attended {messName} at {blockTimes} and left without eating each time.
inmate.missedMeal.meta: Day {day} · caused by the node below

mess.emptyAtMealtime.title: {messName} had {mealsAvailable} meals on the serving counters at {time}
mess.emptyAtMealtime.detail: {routed} inmates were routed to {messName}. {mealsDelivered} meals were delivered. {leftHungry} inmates left hungry, of whom {missedThreePlus} have now missed 3 or more blocks.

kitchen.producedShortfall.title: Kitchen {kitchenName} produced {produced} meals, needed {needed}
kitchen.producedShortfall.detail: Preparation began at {prepStart} as scheduled. Production stopped at capacity.

kitchen.underCapacity.title: Kitchen {kitchenName} has {cookers} cookers and {cooks} assigned cook{cooksPlural}
kitchen.underCapacity.detail: Capacity is {cookers} × {mealsPerCookerPerHour} × {assistFactor} = {mealsPerHour} meals per hour. Serving {needed} inmates in a {prepHours} hour preparation window needs {neededCookers} cookers or {altCookers} cookers and {altCooks} assigned cooks.

kitchen.noIngredients.title: Kitchen {kitchenName} has no ingredients in its fridges
kitchen.noIngredients.detail: Preparation for {needed} meals could not start. Stock at least {variety} distinct ingredient type{varietyPlural}.

kitchen.noCookAssigned.title: Kitchen {kitchenName} has no cook assigned
kitchen.noCookAssigned.detail: {cookers} cooker{cookersPlural} sit idle. Hire a cook or assign kitchen labour before the next meal block.

kitchen.noRouteToMess.title: Kitchen {kitchenName} has no route to a mess hall
kitchen.noRouteToMess.detail: No mess hall is reachable for meal delivery. Build a mess hall or override kitchen routing after researching Delegation.

mess.full.title: {messName} serving counters are full
mess.full.detail: Counters hold {mealsHeld} of {capacity} meals. Kitchen {kitchenName} could not stage {blocked} more meals.

laundry.noRouteToHousing.title: Laundry {laundryName} has no route to a housing block
laundry.noRouteToHousing.detail: No cell or dormitory is available for uniform redistribution. Build housing or override laundry routing after researching Delegation.

laundry.underCapacity.title: Laundry {laundryName} has {machines} washing machine{machinesPlural} and {labour} assigned worker{labourPlural}
laundry.underCapacity.detail: Capacity is {machines} × {uniformsPerMachinePerHour} × {assistFactor} = {uniformsPerHour} uniforms per hour. Serving {needed} inmates needs more machines or labour.

laundry.noLabour.title: Laundry {laundryName} has no labour assigned
laundry.noLabour.detail: {machines} washing machine{machinesPlural} sit idle. Hire a cleaner or assign laundry labour during work blocks.

cleaning.noCleaners.title: No cleaners are working while floors are dirty
cleaning.noCleaners.detail: Mean indoor dirt is {meanDirt}. Hire cleaners, groundskeepers for outdoor tiles, or assign cleaning labour during work blocks.

morale.bribeTaken.title: Officer {officerId} pocketed {contrabandId} during a search
morale.bribeTaken.detail: Staff morale was {morale}. Bribe chance was {chance}. The inmate kept their secret and the officer kept the goods.

morale.strikeStarted.title: Staff walked out — morale fell to {morale}
morale.strikeStarted.detail: Non-emergency staff stop working for 24 hours. A pay demand of +{demandedRaise} is open until they return.

morale.payDemand.title: Staff demand a {demandedRaise} wage rise
morale.payDemand.detail: Accept to raise wages immediately and end the strike. Refuse and the next walkout becomes more likely.

search.performed.title: {kind} search completed
search.performed.detail: Touched {inmatesTouched} inmates and {stashesTouched} stashes. Found {found} items. Mood cost {moodCost}. Staff morale was {morale}.

search.intakeDelayed.title: Intake search delayed inmate {inmateId} by {delayMinutes} minutes

danger.recomputed.title: Danger level is {danger}
danger.recomputed.detail: Critical needs {criticalNeeds}, misconduct {misconduct}, armed {armedInmates}, morale {staffMorale}, coverage {guardCoverage}, max-sec {maxSecurityShare}.

riot.started.title: Riot started — inmate {inmateId}
riot.started.detail: Danger was {danger} across a population of {population}.

riot.contained.title: Riot contained
riot.contained.detail: No rioting inmates for {quietMinutes} continuous minutes.

emergency.riotSquadCalled.title: Riot squad deployed
emergency.riotSquadCalled.detail: {staffIds} units on site at ${hourlyWage}/hour. Fear boost {fearBoost}.

escape.tunnelDiscovered.title: Tunnel from cell entrance {originTile} collapsed
escape.tunnelDiscovered.detail: Found by {method}. Diggers {diggerIds} were punished. Suppression +{suppression}.

escape.inmateEscaped.title: Inmate {inmateId} escaped via {route}
escape.inmateEscaped.detail: {escapesToday} escapes today ({totalEscapes} total). Investigate perimeter, tunnels and zoning.

escape.failureWarning.title: Escape crisis — {escapesToday} escapes today
escape.failureWarning.detail: Warning threshold is {warningPerDay}. {thenNextDay} more tomorrow will fail the facility.

escape.failure.title: Facility failed — escapes out of control
escape.failure.detail: {escapesYesterday} escapes yesterday and {escapesToday} more today crossed the failure line.

fire.overloadMarked.title: Electrical overload
fire.overloadMarked.detail: A power branch was marked overloaded.

contraband.throwInIntercepted.title: Throw-in intercepted
contraband.throwInIntercepted.detail: Officer or dog stopped inmate {inmateId} collecting {itemId} at the perimeter.

failure.riotWarning.title: Uncontained riot — failure warning
failure.riotWarning.detail: Riot has run for {warningHours} hours. Contain it or the facility fails in {thenHours} more.

failure.riot.title: Facility failed — uncontained riot
failure.riot.detail: The riot was not contained within the failure window.

utilities.brownout.title: Power brownout on branch {branchId}
utilities.brownout.detail: Demand {demandWatts}W exceeded capacity {capacityWatts}W by {shortfallWatts}W. Shed priority {priority}.

directorate.paused.title: {branch} research paused — no {administrator}
directorate.paused.detail: {nodeId} needs the {administrator} in post with a functional office. Reason: {reason}. Nothing advances until the post is filled.
